name: Toudou Takami
source: friend and new teacher of Shirou. Her father was original teacher of dojo but injured himself and had to take time off. As heir is every bit as skilled and only Shirou can just barely help her break a sweat. Being very pure and having slight crush on Shirou will at times mistake his compliments as flirting an get flustered.
